name: teacher-membership-pilot-1gpu-20261022
description: Plumbing pilot: direct+verify membership readout, 200 train/dev rows, 2 chains, gold405 checkpoint (archival split; coverage only)
command:
set -euo pipefail
R=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish
V=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare/.venv-sii
CKPT=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare/runs/qz/ms_gold/v1/checkpoint-405
D=$R/data/multiselect_grouped_multi
RUN=$R/runs/qz/teachers_pilot_20261022
LOG=$R/logs/qz/teacher_membership_pilot.log
mkdir -p "$R/logs/qz" "$RUN"
cd "$R"
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
for VIEW in direct verify; do
  MODEL="$CKPT" CHECKPOINT_ID="sha256:b3d3e78e8c7697d0f5793051621b0b2f226958f26618fadaf63ed7727c976282" TEACHER_ID="gold405:$VIEW" TEACHER_VIEW="$VIEW" \
  SAMPLES=2 SHARDS=1 SPLITS="train dev" LIMIT=200 DATA_DIR="$D" RUN_ROOT="$RUN" \
  MAX_TOKENS=4096 MAX_MODEL_LEN=16384 READOUT_MAX_INPUT_TOKENS=16384 \
  Q_TRANSFORM=membership TRUNCATED_POLICY=exclude \
  PYTHON_GENERATE="$V/bin/python" PYTHON_READOUT="$V/bin/python" \
  bash "$R/harness/run_sii_style_teacher.sh" || exit $?
done
echo "JOB EXIT=0"
